# George Popescu AI

> A space for clear, evidence-based thinking about artificial intelligence — exploring AI as interface, embodied intelligence, and the limits of today's AI boom.

George Popescu AI separates signal from noise in the current AI hype cycle. Rather than betting on ever-larger language models, this site explores AI as a powerful human-computer interface and argues that real long-term progress will come from embodied AI — systems that perceive, move, and act in the physical world.
